name: Kindan no Sekai e 2  Saranaru Fukami e
original_name: 禁断の世界へ2 さらなる深みへ
source:
An honors student named Yuma discovered the world of exhibitionism. Unable to forget the sensuality of being naked in public, she continues to do so, everywhere.

Now, Yuma takes it further... and crosses the line.

A new school year has come, and a junior has joined.
Her best friend has a request to go a new way... so once again Yuma discards her clothes and goes into a shameful, exhilarating world...

What do you suppose happens when men see her naked at the intersection? Or when she goes to a game center? How far will Yuma's shame progress?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081890.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
优麻是一名优等生，却发现了露出癖的世界。她无法忘记在众人面前赤身裸体时的情欲，于是继续在各个地方裸露身体。

如今，优麻更进一步……越过了界线。

新学年到来，一名学妹加入了她们。好友又提出要尝试全新玩法……于是优麻再度脱去衣物，踏入羞耻而刺激的世界……

若男人们在十字路口看见赤裸的她，会发生什么？她这样走进游戏厅又会如何？优麻的羞耻游戏究竟会发展到何种地步！？
